The main takeaway from our work is that
the two-loop contributions to the phases of the pion form factors can be expressed in terms of the two-loop ππ scattering amplitude and a few form-factor dependent terms.
the isospin breaking corrections in the ππ scattering phase are not universal, but they depend on the specific form factor under consideration.

the form-factor dependent contributions to the phases of the pion form factors can be determined by means of a two-loop dispersive calculation, without the need to resort to the computation of the form factors themselves.
